summary: Bossier Parish tower built 1948 as the parish's fourth and final tower; a 2002 survey note says it was torn down and no trace of its base was found.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with a glass-enclosed lookout cab
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts page marks it Removed; 2002 survey recovery note reports local information that it was torn down; no removal date given

staffing.status: Operated six months a year, unlike the other towers in the group; watchmen on call around the clock except in heavy rain

events.note: Fourth and final tower in the Bossier group, in the Bolinger area
Coast and Geodetic Survey first observed the survey marker at the tower
2002 recovery note: local information said the tower was torn down; a GPS search found no trace of the tower or its base. The note does not give the date of removal.

evidence.quote: In the early days of the commission, look-out towers, telephone networks, and fire-fighting teams were strategically placed, providing a network of protection for each district in the state.

corrections.why: The NGS mark was taken at the center of the tower base. The list's coordinates sit roughly 150 m east of it.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia says torn down, and the Forest Lookouts page says Removed; the 2002 NGS note reports local information that it was torn down. The three agree that the tower is gone. Wikipedia's map note has its dates out of order, and no source gives a removal date.

sources.title: NGS Datasheet for PID CQ3239 (Bolinger Fire Tower LFC)
List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana

notes_for_editor: Built date and the six-month season come from one 1940s-era local history column; the removal is supported by three sources but none gives a date. 'LFC' on the survey designation is read as the Louisiana Forestry Commission; no source spells that out for this tower. Coordinates in the brief come from Wikipedia; the NGS mark is the better position. AboutUs gives a different point and 111 ft elevation; not used. The FFLOS Louisiana list (six registered sites) does not include Bolinger. No photos found. Used two web searches and six reads.
